description.value: Historic Greenaway Outdoor Pool is a free seasonal outdoor swimming pool operated by the City of Surrey, located in Greenaway Park on 60th Avenue just east of Fraser Downs Racetrack. It offers free public swims and swimming lessons during summer months, making it a welcome refreshment stop for touring cyclists passing through Surrey's south side.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Greenaway Outdoor Pool is a free municipal outdoor pool in Greenaway Park, open seasonally until September 7, 2026. The address (17901 - 60 Avenue, Surrey, BC V3S 6W4) and phone (604-502-6257) on the website match the OSM record. No bike parking, washrooms, showers, or other cyclist amenities are explicitly mentioned on the website, so those are set to null despite being likely for a public pool facility.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free seasonal outdoor pool is a genuinely useful and appealing stop for touring cyclists in summer, offering a chance to cool off and swim at no cost.
